title: Session 51 — Project 2: Microservices Deployment on GKE
subtitle: Session 51

concepts.title: Topics covered
concepts.text_md:
- E-commerce Microservices Architecture design
- Multi-Language Services: Java Python Go .NET
- GKE Kubernetes Cluster configuration and scaling
- Service-to-Service Communication patterns
- API Gateway Pattern for external routing
- Monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana integration

concepts.title: Key learnings
concepts.text_md:
- Microservices means each service can be deployed scaled and updated completely independently
- Each service in its own Kubernetes namespace for clean isolation and independent deployments
- Resource limits on pods prevent one bad service from consuming all cluster resources
- Liveness and readiness probes ensure traffic only routes to pods that are fully healthy
- Netflix Amazon and Google all run microservices on Kubernetes — you are doing what they do

concepts.title: Task 101
concepts.text_md:
